description: Trigger evals: queries that should and should not activate shop-inventory.
positive: Which tools are you still just guessing that I own?
Let's confirm my tool list — I want to lock it down.
I own a DeWalt table saw and a random-orbit sander; mark those confirmed.
Add a router to my shop inventory.
I have six bar clamps and a jigsaw now.
Took stock of the shop today — let's update what I actually have.
negative: I finished the benches — run the post-build close-out.
Design a mudroom bench around my tools.
Does this cut list close on 36 inches?
Help me scope a new garage-shelf idea.
Walk me through the glue-up step at the bench.
notes: Positives are the deliberate tool/material census: confirming inferred entries, adding a newly acquired tool, re-measuring stock. Negatives belong to shop-close-out (post-build feedback ritual), build-planner (design), cut-verifier (numbers), project-intake (scoping), or build-companion (at-the-bench execution). The boundary with shop-close-out: this skill maintains the standing inventory truth; shop-close-out runs the build-linked delta.
